reality_delta: The proposal describes a real recovery path, but it has not yet shown that the regenerated top-level artifacts will be distinguishable from a normal completed run, or that existing evidence can be independently verified as untampered. Until then, the main change is a narrative of completion, not a demonstrated completion.
main_concern: `complete-revival-e2e finalize-existing` risks retroactively manufacturing completion artifacts for a run that hard-timed out. Without unforgeable recovery provenance and strict evidence-integrity checks, an aborted long-run can be turned into a documented success.
top_risks: Evidence reuse becomes a rubber-stamp if 'validate existing evidence' only checks file presence, allowing stale or partial artifacts to certify a run they did not fully complete.
Recovered completion markers may look identical to normal completions, misleading downstream audits about whether the original 1800s run actually finished on its own.
A single `browser-state-mutation-probe` may be too narrow to satisfy Kimi's 'browser interaction coverage too shallow' concern unless it explicitly maps to the real user journeys Kimi flagged.
missing_evidence: Contents or bundle of the six listed evidence files to confirm they exist, are complete, and contain tamper-evident hashes or manifests.
The exact validation algorithm and acceptance thresholds for `reuse and verify existing evidence` in the new finalize-existing entry.
A design for recovery-provenance labeling inside regenerated `final-prism-review`, `iteration-verdict`, `completion-marker`, and `run-summary`.
minimum_fix: 1) Implement manifest+hash validation for every reused evidence file and fail on any mismatch, missing artifact, or out-of-range timestamp. 2) Append a `recoveryProvenance` block to every regenerated artifact, naming the original run id, timeout point, evidence snapshot hash, and the fact that finalization happened post-hoc. 3) Run `browser-state-mutation-probe` against the actually deployed app and produce a coverage matrix linking each mutation check to Kimi's shallow-interaction concern. 4) Write a separate `failure-reflux-audit` with the controlled failure injection log and rollback verification, and make `completion-marker` reference it by hash rather than self-describe. 5) Provide Prism with an authorized evidence bundle so these claims can be verified.

anti_loop_signal.reason: Do not accept 'we generated the missing top-level JSONs' as proof the E2E succeeded. The real test is whether an independent reviewer, given only the evidence bundle, can distinguish a recovered run from an uninterrupted run and still accept the recovered one on its merits.

user_intent_alignment: The user wants the real long-run sample unblocked without documentation-as-completion or lowered acceptance. The recovery-only design aligns only if it proves the original run produced enough genuine evidence and honestly labels the recovery; otherwise it drifts into exactly the substitute the user rejected.
